sonnet.problem: Choice card 5 already asked what the enemies say they want to do to Israel, and its right answer was 'erase Israel as a nation'. This story card then quotes verse 4 in full, 'let us erase them as a nation', so it reuses the answer the baker just saw.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
